name: Baseline
description: Plain helpful-assistant instruction. No glossary, no explicit grounding rule, language only implied by the question.

name: Glossary + grounding
description: Adds the language-specific glossary block and a rule to answer only from the policy context, in the user's language.

name: Strict numbers + fallback
description: v2 plus explicit handling of numbers and dates (copy them verbatim from context) and an instruction to say when the policy does not cover the question.
